description: Sturdy Circular Saw Build – Designed for heavy-duty jobsite and workshop tasks, the Bosch GKS 190 circular saw offers unmatched strength, power, and long-term durability. Quick Blade Change Mechanism – With a spindle lock system, the Bosch circular saw enables fast and hassle-free blade replacements for uninterrupted workflow. Clear View Air Blower – Built-in air blower clears dust and chips from the cutting line, ensuring better visibility and accurate cuts during woodworking tasks. Left-Hand Friendly Design – Lightweight at 4.1 kg and engineered for comfortable use, this Bosch power tool is suitable for both right- and left-handed professionals.
